observations.fact: Guest-source IPv4 and DNS exchanges use 198.18.0.2 and TAP resolver 198.18.0.1.
Four PTR questions for 2.0.18.198.in-addr.arpa and four A questions for gate1.us.dnas.playstation.org received REFUSED responses from the local deny-recursion resolver.
Client screenshots show DNAS Authentication Connecting, then DNAS Error (-611).

The guest alternated DNS questions between 5.161.217.188:53 and 198.18.0.1:53 despite DHCP ACK logs advertising only the lab resolver. Eight questions went to each destination; only the lab destination has recorded replies. Endpoint-selection origin remains UNKNOWN.
Denied name resolution is the immediate observed network blocker associated with the DNAS-stage error; a controlled differential is needed to establish causation and the next protocol step.
Successful DNAS behavior, resolved original service address, post-resolution transport/bytes, required compatibility mechanism, account/game exchanges and hardware/revision differences.
